info.name:
Get all accounts that the user has access to, filter by name (contains), account ids, organization ids, and/or account states (0 = Active, 1 = Deactivated, 2 = All).
Sort options include: name = 0, numProjects = 1, numPeople = 2, numMembers = 3 and organizationId = 4
Sort order options include: asc = 0, desc = 1

items.docs: NOTE: Paging limit defaults to 50, and is maximized at 100 items per request. If there are more accounts than were returned, there will be a "query-has-more" header that will be set to true.

info.name: Get all custom field values for all people for the given account

params.name: id
params.description: The Account ID

params.name: includeEmpty
params.description: If true, the response will include all person field values, even if no value is set for a given field. If false, field values that are empty are not included in the response.

params.name: state
params.description:
If specified and non-zero, only include field vlaues for people matching the given state. The available values are defined as follows:
- active: include only Active people
- deactivated: include only Deactivated people
- all: include all people, regardless of state

params.name: personIds
params.description: Optional paramater of comma delimited ids for filtering results based on the person IDs provided

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset of the result to begin with

params.name: limit
params.description: Optional - The number of items return by result set. If no limit given, return all results

params.name: employeeId
params.description: Optional - for filtering result by system field "Employee ID"

When a project ID is supplied, the results will be constrained to the persons within that project. If the project ID is omitted, the results will pull for the entire account and can be filtered by person IDs.
